## Runs 6 and 7 — raw SdH checks and fan-design read

Recipe: `sdh-spot-check`; governing `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count`, Steps 2–4. Raw signed Rxx and current/leakage/temperature precede onset and FFT. Both runs completed without rails (Rxx maxima 530/587 Ohm against 5 kOhm full scale), drain 9.81–9.94 nA, sample 1.165–1.292 K. Only sr1/B1–B2 is connected as Rxx; no Hall or other spatial channel is available.

The electron trace at n_A=+3.2 has reproducible candidate tones around 7, 14, 22 and 29 T; integer relationships and the two zero-field ridges make pocket assignment ambiguous. The full 0.3–10 T polynomial fit returns a censored low-field onset and large residual-background tones: it is not a valid basis for an expensive low-field fan. Limiting the onset fit to 0.3–5 T, before the large 8–9 T MR hump, and excluding the <4 T residual band gives **1.018, 1.018, 1.042 T** for degrees 3, 5, 7. The carrying 6.7–6.8 T tone is uncensored in all three fits; its onset is near the 1 T transition to fine sampling, so retain an onset/sampling uncertainty and do not claim sub-1 T absence. The <4 T exclusion is only for design: it is not a claim that smaller pockets are absent. Higher-frequency tones turn on around 1.3–1.8 T; their shorter usable records must be used for final resolution claims.

The hole trace at n_A=-1.2 has onset 0.71 T, but the model ABAB tones there are **5.86 and 6.54 T**, separated by only 0.68 T against deltaF=0.77 T even out to 10 T. Its cleaner oscillations therefore cannot separate that pair. Choose the electron side, where the calibrated gate window reaches the discriminating density regime.

**Current verdict, B1–B2: uninformative for stacking.** The spots advance the campaign by establishing oscillations, timing and an attainable fan window; they do not yet supply a reliable pocket count. The next fan tests dispersion and grid reproduction. The FS model predicts ABAB (6.04,22.91) T at n=2.8 and (7.31,25.78) T at n=3.2; ABCA gives F_L=28.95–33.09 T. Values were computed with `hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count/fs_count_b0.py:abab_fs` (density in m^-2). A global scale fit, harmonic screen, and ABAB plus trilayer overlays remain mandatory before classification; any F_L-like tone needs its origin discrimination.

Calibration caveat/correction to cell 12: the stored secondary-ridge offset is n_B_offset=-0.426 versus n_A_offset=-0.089, so at identical gates **n_B=n_A-0.337**, not a +0.43 increase. Parallel ridges alone do not establish stacking domains or a shared D-zero. Keep that extra-region hypothesis separate from the single-global-scale template fits. Absolute capacitance remains a geometry prior; the narrow accessible high-density window may leave branch-trajectory discrimination inconclusive.

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, sdh_onset, sdh_fft
from scipy.signal import find_peaks

for fid, density in [(6, 3.2), (7, -1.2)]:
    run_s = open_run(f'data/{fid}')
    channels_s = {c.cid:c for c in resolve_channels(run_s.meta)}
    field_s = run_s.col('magnet_field')
    current_s = run_s.col('sr0_X') / channels_s['sr0'].gain
    resistance_s = (run_s.col('sr1_X') / channels_s['sr1'].gain) / current_s
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(11, 6))
    axes[0,0].plot(field_s, resistance_s)
    axes[0,0].set(ylabel='Signed Rxx B1-B2 (Ohm)', title=f'Run {fid}, n={density:+.1f}, D=0')
    axes[0,1].plot(field_s, current_s*1e9); axes[0,1].set_ylabel('Drain current (nA)')
    for col in ['k_2400_tg_curr','k_2400_bg_curr']:
        axes[1,0].plot(field_s, run_s.col(col)*1e12, label=col)
    axes[1,0].set_ylabel('Gate current (pA)'); axes[1,0].legend()
    axes[1,1].plot(field_s, run_s.col('T_sample')); axes[1,1].set_ylabel('Sample T (K)')
    for a in axes.flat: a.set_xlabel('B (T)')
    fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()
    print(f'Run {fid}: complete={not run_s.interrupted}, Rxx={resistance_s.min():.2f}..{resistance_s.max():.2f} Ohm; I={current_s.min()*1e9:.3f}..{current_s.max()*1e9:.3f} nA')
    # The full 0.3-10 T background fit is shown as a diagnostic, not silently accepted.
    print('Full-window onset diagnostic:')
    print(sdh_onset(resistance_s, field_s, r_full_scale=5000).summary())
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12,4))
    for degree_s in [3,5,7]:
        if fid == 6:
            onset_s = sdh_onset(resistance_s, field_s, b_hi=5, f_min=4, bg_degree=degree_s, r_full_scale=5000)
            print(f'0.3-5 T onset, degree {degree_s}:\n{onset_s.summary()}')
            for tone_s in onset_s.tones:
                if 6 < tone_s.freq < 8:
                    axes[0].plot(tone_s.b_centers,tone_s.snr,label=f'{tone_s.freq:.2f} T, degree {degree_s}')
        for lower_s in [1.5, 2.0]:
            freq_s, spec_s = sdh_fft(resistance_s[:,None], field_s, b_range=(lower_s,6.5), bg_degree=degree_s, log=False, nfft=4096)
            mask_s=(freq_s>4)&(freq_s<45)
            axes[1].plot(freq_s,spec_s[0]/max(spec_s[0,mask_s]),label=f'{lower_s}-6.5 T, degree {degree_s}')
    axes[0].axhline(5,color='k',ls=':'); axes[0].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='Matched-filter SNR')
    if fid==6: axes[0].legend(fontsize=7)
    axes[1].axvline(abs(density)*10.33916924,color='k',ls='--',label='nominal F_L')
    axes[1].set(xlim=(4,45),ylim=(0,1.2),xlabel='F (T)',ylabel='FFT / maximum in 4-45 T'); axes[1].legend(fontsize=7)
    fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — electron-side D≈0 Landau fan for the stacking investigation

> **05:26** · D0 electron fan: n=2.8-3.2e12 cm^-2, B=1.018-6.5 T, 239x11, base T, 10 nA, 3 s dwell · **ETA ~09:16** (≈3h50m)

`landau-fan-vti` implementing `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` Step 4. Gates A/B are green (setup, SAFETIES cell 18, VERIFY cell 32), Gate C passed on runs 0–3, and the handoff readback/probe in cells 44/46 confirms bring-up state and the same bound kernel under the recorded E1 grant. Runs 6/7 are now analyzed in ana cells 14–15: holes are cleaner but their reachable ABAB pair is unresolved; electrons have multiple tones whose dispersion and harmonic relationships need a fan. Calibration is the same rounded run-5 conversion used by the spots (ratio data-calibrated, absolute scale geometry-prior, D zero inferred from CNP symmetry); the additional CNP ridge remains a spatial/doping confound.

**Computed design and cost floor.** Electron density n_A=2.8–3.2×10¹² cm⁻², D_A=0. `sdh_onset` on run 6's 0.3–5 T record gives B_lo=1.017618 T (degree 3/5/7: 1.018/1.018/1.042 T); the large high-field MR background corrupts the full-range low-field onset. The model's smallest ABAB partner in this density window is 6.0379 T: B_hi=6.5 T is the first 0.1 T endpoint giving five nominal periods (5.004); deltaF=1.207 T. The ABAB heavy branch 22.91–25.78 T lies 6.04–7.31 T below nominal F_L=28.95–33.09 T. Higher-tone onsets around 1.4–1.8 T shorten their usable records; resolution and period counts are design expectations, not guaranteed detection or absence bounds.

Run 6 also resolves higher tones up to about 130 T, so sampling only nominal F_L risks harmonic folding. Use a 143 T design ceiling (10% margin) and its two-sample Nyquist floor: **239 uniform-1/B rows**, delta(1/B)=0.0034825 T⁻¹, Nyquist=143.57 T. The density-ray floor at B_lo, allowing 20% capacitance-scale uncertainty, gives **11 density points**, delta n=0.04×10¹² cm⁻² (minimum ray spacing 0.082×10¹² in nominal coordinates). This is 2,629 points. Fast dwell is 3 s=10tau at tau=0.3 s, 24 dB/oct; fixed sr1 50 µV=5 kOhm nominal full scale retains substantial margin above the spot's 530 Ohm maximum and a conservative lower-density MR increase. No autoranging.

**Timing basis:** run 5 measured 1.098 s/point at 1 s dwell and NPLC=1; run 6 field steps took 7.464 s for 10 mT, leaving about 3.08 s beyond the 4.38 s ramp. Allow 3.18 s/point for the paired gates and extra logfile/field read, plus 5.5 s per row for magnet settle, flyback and slow delay. Ramp 0→1.018 T costs 7.4 min; the complete 0→6.5 T excursion costs 47.5 min at 0.137 T/min. Grid 139.3 min + row costs 21.9 min + ramp, with 10% contingency, gives about 3 h 50 min. Field starts from actual near-zero and ends at 6.5 T for possible follow-up; no return traverse is hidden in this estimate.

**Coverage trade:** exclude holes, CNP and lower electron densities: holes lack the resolvable design pair, while the lower electron partner would have fewer than five periods in this field window. Full accessible D=0 coverage (−1.27…+3.27) at the same density/field spacing would need about 115 density points and roughly 27 h, while still not resolving those low-density partners. This compact high-density slice can test pocket partition and grid reproduction; its short density span may leave ABAB versus adjacent-N/ABCB trajectory discrimination inconclusive. No whole-flake or strong stacking verdict is promised.

**Checkpoints:** inspect the first three landed rows for current, temperature, rails and leakage; inspect again at 30 min and every 30 min thereafter, with a per-column FFT check once sufficient 1/B span has landed. Weak oscillations at the first/onset rows alone are not grounds for abort. Every followed value is plotted. The cell reads validators, temperature freshness, heater ranges, Si state, drive/filter settings and gate pacing before any write; per-point guards retain the prior 1 nA leakage threshold and stop on thermal/current/rail/field anomalies. On a safety stop, drop to E0 and notify Zack. **VTI magnet caveat:** a kernel interrupt does not halt an in-flight supply ramp; it may continue to the current row target. Re-read actual field after every interruption; any physical ramp abort belongs to the operator.

# landau-fan-vti: electron-side D=0, calibrated to ridge A of run 5.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# Read-only preflight: committed safety surfaces must equal the device card.
for _p, _expected in [(k_tg.volt,(-0.3,1.0)), (k_bg.volt,(-1.3,2.0)),
                       (dc205.smart_voltage,(-25.,25.)), (dc205.voltage,(-25.,25.)),
                       (magnet.field,(-10.,10.)), (heater.sample_setpoint,(0.,100.)),
                       (heater.vaporizer_setpoint,(0.,100.))]:
    _actual=(float(_p.vals._min_value),float(_p.vals._max_value))
    print(f'{_p.full_name}: expected validator {_expected}, actual {_actual}')
    assert _actual == _expected
assert B_SESSION_CAP == 10.0 and T_SESSION_CAP == 100.0
assert k_tg is k_2400_tg and k_bg is k_2400_bg and k_si is dc205.smart_voltage
for _name in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
    assert_thermometry_live(_name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_name],max_age=15,max_period=12)
_Ts,_Tv,_B = T_sample(),T_vaporizer(),magnet.field()
_ranges=(heater.sample_range(),heater.vaporizer_range())
_ps=(magnet.persistent_switch_on(),magnet.output_enabled())
_si=(dc205.voltage_range(),dc205.output(),k_si(),dc205.ramp_rate)
print(f'Expected base: Ts 1.0..1.5 K, Tv<1.6 K, |Tv-Ts|<0.6 K, ranges (0,0); actual {_Ts}, {_Tv}, {_ranges}')
print(f'Expected |B|<0.05 T, PS/output on; actual {_B}, {_ps}; Si expected RNGE2/on/0V/0.5V/s; actual {_si}')
assert 1.0<=_Ts<=1.5 and 0<_Tv<1.6 and abs(_Tv-_Ts)<0.6 and _ranges==(0,0)
assert abs(_B)<0.05 and all(_ps)
assert _si[0]==2 and _si[1]==1 and abs(_si[2])<0.01 and _si[3]==0.5
_tau=(sr0.time_constant(),sr1.time_constant())
_slopes=(sr0.filter_slope(),sr1.filter_slope())
_drive=(sr1.amplitude(),sr1.frequency())
_pacing=(k_tg.volt.step,k_bg.volt.step)
_nplc=(k_tg.nplci(),k_bg.nplci())
print(f'Expected tau (.3,.3), slopes (24,24), drive (1 V,13.777 Hz), gate steps (.005,.005), NPLC (1,1); actual {_tau}, {_slopes}, {_drive}, {_pacing}, {_nplc}')
assert _tau==(.3,.3) and _slopes==(24,24)
assert abs(_drive[0]-1)<1e-6 and abs(_drive[1]-13.777)<.01
assert _pacing==(.005,.005) and _nplc==(1,1)
assert WIRING=={'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2','sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'} and 'mux' not in globals()
assert meas_config['sr0_gain']==-1e6 and meas_config['bias_resistor']==100e6 and meas_config['bias_channel']=='sr1'

CAL_FAN=dict(c_tg=2.796e-3,c_bg=2.161e-3,n_offset=-.0894,D_offset=-.013)
ns_fan=np.linspace(3.2,2.8,11)
Vtgs_fan,Vbgs_fan=calc_gate_voltages(ns_fan,np.zeros(11),**CAL_FAN)
B_fan=field_invB(1.017617880804576,6.5,239)
for _p,_vals in [(k_tg.volt,Vtgs_fan),(k_bg.volt,Vbgs_fan),(magnet.field,B_fan)]:
    for _v in _vals: _p.validate(float(_v))
_ncheck,_Dcheck=calc_nD(Vtgs_fan,Vbgs_fan,**CAL_FAN)
assert np.allclose(_ncheck,ns_fan) and np.max(np.abs(_Dcheck))<1e-10
print(f'Fan: {len(B_fan)} x {len(ns_fan)}; B {B_fan[0]:.6f}->{B_fan[-1]:.3f} T; TG {Vtgs_fan.min():.6f}..{Vtgs_fan.max():.6f}, BG {Vbgs_fan.min():.6f}..{Vbgs_fan.max():.6f} V')
print(f'Bare ramp total from actual {_B:+.4f} T: {(6.5-_B)*7.3:.1f} min; first row positioning {(B_fan[0]-_B)*7.3:.1f} min. No extra field traverse.')
# Acquisition settings only; validators, driver step, ramp_rate, and heaters untouched.
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
assert sr1.sensitivity()==50e-6 and sr0.sensitivity()==.02
mc_fan=dict(meas_config)
mc_fan.update({'Si (V)':_si[2],'sample_temperature:':_Ts,'calibration':CAL_FAN,
               'n_vector_1e12_cm2':ns_fan.tolist(),'D_V_nm':0.,'settling_s':3.,
               'comments':'D0 electron fan; ridge-A run5 calibration; n 3.2->2.8, B 1.017618->6.5 T; 239x11; sr1 50uV, 10nA, tau0.3s/24dB, dwell3s; no contact rerouting'})
s=sweep.AsyncStation(mc_fan)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment('tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step4; n_A=3.2->2.8e12 cm^-2 (11), D_A=0 V/nm; B=1.0176178808->6.5 T (239 uniform-1/B); Si=0 V; B1-B2 Rxx; cal run5 ratio=.773, absolute scale geometry prior; first 3 rows and every 30min checkpoints')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,float(Vbgs_fan[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt,float(Vtgs_fan[0]))
interruptible_sleep(3)
# Every recorded channel is also visible in the live monitor.
# Row: time, B_set, TG_set, BG_set, Ts, Tv, Itg, Ibg, sr0X, sr0P, sr1X, sr1P, B_read.
B_read_fan=qcodes.Parameter('B_read_fan',get_cmd=magnet.field,unit='T')
for _param in (T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P,B_read_fan):
    s.fp(_param)
    s.plot('time',_param)
_fan_guard={'last_fresh':0.0,'reason':None}
def fan_guard(station,data):
    _why=[]
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(np.asarray(data,dtype=float))): _why.append('nonfinite reading')
    if not (1.0<=float(data[4])<=1.5 and 0<float(data[5])<1.6 and abs(float(data[5])-float(data[4]))<.6): _why.append('base temperature mismatch')
    if max(abs(float(data[6])),abs(float(data[7])))>1e-9: _why.append('inherited 1nA gate-current trip')
    if abs(float(data[10]))>=.9*50e-6 or abs(float(data[8]))>=.9*.02: _why.append('lock-in near full scale')
    if not 8e-9<float(data[8])/-1e6<12e-9: _why.append('drain-current mismatch')
    if abs(float(data[12])-float(data[1]))>.03: _why.append('measured field mismatch')
    if time.monotonic()-_fan_guard['last_fresh']>30:
        try:
            for _name in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
                assert_thermometry_live(_name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_name],max_age=15,max_period=12)

      f"roundtrip n,D = {calc_nD(Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot, CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (expect 10 T: the electron spot check ended there), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0 - 10.0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.arange(10.0, 0.2999, -0.02), 4))[::-1]   # 10 -> 0.3 T, 20 mT
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity: 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA (R(B=0) ~ 250-300 Ohm near the CNP side; MR + SdH maxima at 10 T size the headroom).
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check hole: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 10 -> 0.3 T, 20 mT, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'hole side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 10 -> 0.3 T uniform-B 20 mT (ride-down); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 0.3 T — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
